answer: Onyx-sealed inlet commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 credits and posts an inlet reading hash at an onyx stake. At the epoch horizon each reveals reading and key; the auditor checks it on the public table; a miss or mismatch before the horizon burns the bond. One key opens one commit. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits and pay 15 per reveal, 85,000 in all, yet each fake needs its own reading, so rented reveals fail. Honest agents pay 15 once.
